lead.kicker: BEFORE KICKOFF · LATE GAMES · IPADE · WEEK 6
lead.headline: Stroud scored 23 on your bench and Taylor is slow — you still lead by 25.5
lead.deck: Gay, Golden, Pickens and Daniels are cleared and still to play; ESPN gives Bloodsports 75%.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. C.J. Stroud threw three touchdowns in London and scored 23.0 on your bench; that was the projection's call, Daniels 18.9 to Stroud 12.8, and it is graded on Monday's result, not on Stroud's. Jonathan Taylor has 8.6 an hour in, with Tyler Warren inactive and Seth McGowan still taking snaps; Garrett Wilson has 2.5. Rashee Rice is out and Josh Jacobs waits until Week 7. The rest is clear: Matt Gay, Matthew Golden, George Pickens and Jayden Daniels are off their final reports, and CeeDee Lamb's clearance is already in Pickens's number. Bloodsports lead Los Cachanillas 49 to 23.5.
